widget.name: Resource Planner
widget.description: Display a monthly planning grid with resources as rows and days as columns.

property.caption: Visible month attribute
property.description: DateTime attribute whose month and year define the visible planner month.

property.caption: Show weekends
property.description: Determines whether Saturday and Sunday columns are displayed.

property.caption: First day of week
property.description: Controls weekday labels used by the planner.

property.caption: Resources data source
property.description: List of resources to display as planner rows.

property.caption: Resource title
property.description: Text displayed in the sticky resource column.

property.caption: Resource subtitle
property.description: Optional secondary text displayed below the resource title.

property.caption: Entries data source
property.description: List of entries to display in the planner. Filter to the visible month in the Mendix model when needed.

property.caption: Resource association
property.description: Reference from each entry to the resource row it belongs to.

property.caption: Entry date
property.description: DateTime attribute used to place the entry in a day cell.

property.caption: Entry title
property.description: Primary text displayed on each entry card.

property.caption: Entry subtitle
property.description: Optional secondary text displayed on each entry card.

property.caption: Entry color class
property.description: Optional CSS class appended to entry cards for custom color styling.

property.caption: On resource click
property.description: Action executed when a resource row header is clicked.

property.caption: On entry click
property.description: Action executed when an entry card is clicked.

property.caption: On empty cell click
property.description: Action executed when an empty resource/day cell is clicked. Provides resourceGuid and date action variables.

property.caption: Resource column width
property.description: Width in pixels of the sticky resource column.

property.caption: Day column minimum width
property.description: Minimum width in pixels of each day column.

property.caption: Height mode
property.description: Controls how much vertical space the planner uses.

property.caption: Visible resource rows
property.description: Number of resource rows visible before the planner starts virtual scrolling.
